items.title: CMS releases implementation timeline guidance for updates to No Surprises Act independent dispute resolution process - American Hospital Association
items.reason: CMS guidance on IDR process implementation timeline directly addresses rulemaking and operational updates to the No Surprises Act, which is core to the topic.
items.summary: CMS released implementation timeline guidance for updates to the No Surprises Act's Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process, providing hospitals and other stakeholders with specific dates and requirements for compliance with procedural changes. The guidance clarifies how healthcare providers and insurers must adjust their IDR operations to align with recent regulatory modifications. This affects revenue-cycle teams managing dispute resolution workflows and claim appeals, as they must adjust processes and systems to meet the new compliance deadlines. The update is significant because delays or misalignment with CMS timelines can result in improper handling of disputes and potential penalties for non-compliance.
